title: NAF record line on the scoreboard
body: The match recorder's scoreboard shows each coach's NAF Glicko rating and W/T/L record, read from the coach's NAF page and refreshed when a fixture starts.

title: Coach titles by percentile
body: Coach titles now come from the coach's percentile in the active pool: Legend is the top 2 %, and a coach with fewer than 10 games is a Rookie.

title: Phone layout for the match recorder
body: The match recorder fits a 375 px phone: actions open in bottom sheets and every tap target is bigger.

title: Tournaments: submissions, roster lock, pairing, roles
body: Coaches submit a team and see whether it is valid; the opponent's team can be viewed; organisers lock rosters and start the event in one click, pair rounds with Dutch or Monrad, and run it from the Manage tab. Admins get a tournaments page.
